comment: Copy to agents/agents.local.json (git-ignored) to choose this machine's harness and models without touching agents.json. Only the keys you write are changed. This example runs every agent on Claude Code with the signed-in subscription and gives each stage a model that fits it: a fast one screens papers (research-watch), the strongest reads the relevant ones in depth (the three research agents), one plans (orchestrator), a cheap one implements (autoresearch), and another reviews (code-review; pass --model for a harder review).
